Turnstile is rendered programmatically with no data-sitekey or data-callback, so solveCaptcha cannot inject a token. Submit enables only once Turnstile passes on its own and the form is valid.
emailed link opens /opt-out-removal with name, email and ticket id prefilled and disabled

The removal page is often reloaded behind a Cloudflare check shortly after the form first renders, and values filled before that are lost, leaving Submit disabled. Turnstile only issues its token on the settled page, so wait for it before filling.
phonebooks only matches a record on its exact DOB or street address. The street is only on the profile page, so fetch profileUrl and fill street, city, state and zip from its current address.
